name: What kind of damage does a storm restoration company fix?

mainEntity.name: What kind of damage does a storm restoration company fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storm restoration companies specialize in repairing damage caused by various weather events. This includes structural damage from wind, hail, or falling trees; water damage from heavy rain, flooding, or burst pipes due to freezing; and roof damage. Services often extend to debris removal, board-ups, temporary repairs, and comprehensive reconstruction to return your property to its pre-storm condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Storm restoration companies fix structural damage, water damage, roof damage, and provide debris removal and reconstruction services after severe weather.
